document_path: Workspace/package-edit document behavior is unchanged. Cache hits retain typed fields and unused-key diagnostics.
fallback: Collisions, invalid/truncated/trailing/corrupt entries, unsupported float/datetime/reserved datetime key/depth/size, permission/path errors and I/O failures retain the original TOML path.
first_use: Misses retain original TOML deserialization and may additionally parse to a TOML value, encode JSON and write a slot.
footprint_limits: Committed records only, not total writes, temporary files, syscall count, or measured production hit count.
key: Keyed BLAKE3 of exact manifest contents; parser key includes magic, Cargo.lock, package version and embedded Cargo commit.
payload: JSON of supported TOML values; exact content key plus keyed payload checksum precede typed deserialization.
platform: Unix only; registry and sparse-registry manifests with ohm-defaults enabled
private_files: Owned private directory and regular files; trusted ancestors; no-follow/nonblocking entry open; atomic temporary-file persistence.
